title: Scrapling Output Mapping Contract v1.0
description: Meta-schema for the Scrapling integration contract (§14). Covers both execution modes (§14.1): MCP tool call (interactive ad-hoc) and local script (cron/batch/monitoring). Registers the 4 canonical S1-S4 scenarios (§14.2): weekly competitor snapshot, monthly external mentions, weekly price monitor, and post-publish self audit. Every scenario MUST declare tier_escalation as the fixed sequence ['get','fetch','stealthy_fetch'] (§14.5) and MUST point at an output_schema_file under templates/scrapling/. URL normalization is inherited from the global pipeline — staging rows written from Scrapling output carry both url_original and url_normalized.

mcp_server_name.description: MCP server short name for interactive mode (§14.1). Local script mode does not use the MCP server.

url_normalization.description: Output_schema_file sub-schemas all carry url + url_normalized fields; join keys use url_normalized.

scenarios.description: The 4 canonical scenarios (§14.2). Keys are the fixed vocabulary S1_..S4_..

fetchMethod.description: One rung of the Scrapling tier_escalation ladder (§14.5).

tierEscalation.description: Fixed canonical order per §14.5: get → fetch → stealthy_fetch. Local scripts and MCP mode both walk this ladder. Non-canonical orderings are a schema violation.

autonomousRule.description: Declarative trigger → master_task appender (S3/S4). Either threshold (numeric delta) or value (boolean/exact) must be set.

output_schema_file.description: Relative path under templates/scrapling/ to the per-scenario output sub-schema (§14.3).

local_script_reference.description: Template path with {slug} placeholder — resolved per-project at runtime.

cadence.description: Free-form cadence tag (e.g. 'weekly_monday_09h', 'monthly', 'weekly_friday_18h OR post_publish_48h'). Used by Cowork reminder scheduler.

selector_source.description: Dot-path into project config for per-domain CSS selectors (S1).
